t: New York Central System Historical Society
s: The New York Central System (NYCS) was a Class 1 railroad that ran from St. Louis in the west to Boston in the east, north to Canada, and South to New York City with the premier station, Grand Central Terminal, and corporate headquarters. Its famed "Water Level Route" - from New York City, north to Albany NY and then west through Buffalo NY, Cleveland OH, and onto Chicago - is still used by Amtrak today.
